title: Thread
logline: A handloom weaver turns thread into cloth, and cloth into a named thing someone will wear.
human_question: At what moment does a pile of thread become 'a cloth', and where does 'the cloth' go when it is taken apart?

premise.story: One piece of cloth from spool to buyer, following the weaver's work, skill and livelihood.
premise.place: A weaving household or workshop where the loom sets the rhythm of the day.
premise.experience: The hypnotic loom and the slow appearance of a whole that was never anything but thread.

concept_links.why: The Margaya's own example: cloth divided into threads disappears, so cloth is a concept, thread the more basic reality.
A whole analysed into its parts, the same move later applied to a 'person'.

what_camera_could_observe: Spools, warp and weft, shuttle rhythm
The cloth measured, cut, named and sold
what_must_be_real: The weaver's real work, orders and economics. Nothing is staged for the metaphor.

possible_arc.opening: Loose thread and silence before the loom starts.
possible_arc.turn: A pattern emerges and gets a name.
possible_arc.ending_open: The cloth leaves with a buyer, or is unpicked. Reality decides.

requirements: An active handloom with a willing weaver
A complete piece made within the filming window
Good natural sound of the loom

suggestions.name: Thalagune handloom village
suggestions.verify: Confirm weaving is still active and who to approach.

suggestions.name: Henawala (Dumbara mat weaving)
suggestions.why: Traditional Dumbara weaving; mats rather than cloth, so the premise would adapt.
suggestions.verify: Confirm the craft is practised now.

drop_if: No weaver with a real commission or stake during the filming window

connections.note: Both ask where a whole goes when its parts change.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: All content is editorial proposal. Location suggestions are AI suggestions only; selection belongs to Chathura.
